exposure: Time from labor induction to active labor
Epidural analgesia vs. no epidural analgesia
cohort: 102 low-risk pregnant women at 39 weeks + 0 days to 40 weeks + 6 days of gestation with an unfavorable cervix
finding: Slow-release vaginal dinoprostone is safe and effective for labor induction in low-risk pregnant women, but the cesarean section rate was higher in nulliparous women and those who did not receive epidural analgesia.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was higher in nulliparous women and those who did not receive epidural analgesia during labor.
